title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 158 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 158 - Credit of Advance Tax Any amount paid by or recovered from a taxpayer by way of advance tax without penalty or interest shall be deemed to have been paid on the income earned for the period and the tax so paid shall be deducted from the assessed tax payable by the taxpayer.
